sv.title: Trumps konton handlade Nvidia för mångmiljonbelopp
sv.summary: USA:s president Donald Trumps aktieförvaltare har handlat intensivt i Nvidia-aktien under det senaste året, enligt kontoutdrag som CNBC gått igenom och rapporterar om.

en.title: Trump's accounts bought Nvidia for multi-million amounts
en.summary: US President Donald Trump's investment manager has traded heavily in Nvidia shares over the past year, according to account statements that CNBC has reviewed and reports on.
